SAC saves steps, not compute. That's why PPO is chosen in simulation, where a step costs almost nothing and thousands of robots run in parallel, and off-policy methods on a real robot, where every step means seconds of work and wear.

Off-policy метод учится без взаимодейств: Does an off-policy method learn without interacting with the world?
Да, ему хватает чужих записей: Yes, records collected by others are enough for it
Нет: он сам собирает опыт, но может учит: No: it collects experience itself, but it can learn from transitions collected by any policy, including its own old versions
Нет, off-policy — это только про обучени: No, off-policy is only about training in simulation
SAC в лаборатории 1 сам сделал все 750 ш: SAC in Lab 1 made all 750 steps itself. The difference from PPO lies elsewhere: the target value for the Q-function does not depend on which policy chose the recorded action, so old transitions from the buffer keep teaching.
Зачем DQN буфер воспроизведения, если мо: Why does DQN need a replay buffer if it can learn from each new transition right away?
Переходы подряд похожи друг на друга, а: Consecutive transitions are alike, and a random batch from the buffer breaks this correlation; besides, each transition teaches many times
Чтобы сеть видела только самые свежие да: So that the network sees only the freshest data
Авторы DQN называют обе причины. В интер: The DQN authors name both reasons. In the interactive, without the buffer, on the last 32 transitions in a row, the average success on the last tests dropped from 96 to 52%, and the curve jumps around.
Почему PPO не может просто учиться дальш: Why can't PPO just keep learning from old rollouts, the way SAC learns from its buffer?
Может, просто так не принято: It can, it just isn't done
Градиент политики оценивают по действиям: The policy gradient is estimated from the actions of the policy that chose them: after an update, the rollout describes a different policy, and clipping at 1 ± ε doesn't let the policy move far from it
Старые порции занимают слишком много пам: Old rollouts take up too much memory
Отношение вероятностей r(θ) сравнивает н: The probability ratio r(θ) compares the new policy with the one that collected the rollout. When the policy moves beyond 1 ± ε, the gradient becomes zero, and the rollout teaches nothing more. The Q-function needs no such restriction.
Можно ли управлять рукой с 7 суставами ч: Can you control an arm with 7 joints through DQN by splitting each motor's range into “back, stop, forward”?
Плохо: действий станет 3⁷ = 2187, а для: Poorly: there would be 3⁷ = 2187 actions, precise control needs finer steps, and searching for the maximum over them is hard
Нет, DQN работает только с картинками: No, DQN works only with images
Этот пример приводят авторы DDPG. Вместо: This example comes from the DDPG authors. Instead of enumerating actions, DDPG trains a separate actor network that outputs the action, and the critic Q(s, a) tells it which way to shift it.
Зачем TD3 и SAC две Q-функции?: Why do TD3 and SAC need two Q-functions?
Чтобы усреднить их и получить точнее: To average them and get a more accurate estimate
Чтобы брать меньшую из двух оценок в цел: To take the smaller of the two estimates in the target value: a maximum over a noisy estimate systematically inflates it
Чтобы одна училась на старых данных, а д: So that one learns from old data and the other from new data
Это переоценка: политика тянется туда, г: This is overestimation: the policy is drawn to where Q is mistakenly high, and the error accumulates through the target value. The minimum of two independent estimates may underestimate, but the TD3 authors consider this the lesser evil: the policy does not choose an underestimated action.
Чем больше температура α, тем лучше SAC: Is it true that the higher the temperature α, the better SAC explores and the better the result?
Да, исследования много не бывает: Yes, you can never have too much exploration
Нет: при α = 1 Ада почти не доезжала ни: No: at α = 1, Ada hardly ever reached either shelf, and the policy became almost uniformly random
Нет, α влияет только на скорость обучени: No, α affects only the speed of learning
При α = 0,01 почти все попытки шли к одн: At α = 0.01, almost all attempts went to one shelf, and at α = 1, only 3% of attempts ended at the shelves. That's why in the second version of SAC (2018), α tunes itself: the policy's entropy is held near the target. And a Gaussian policy can't split the attempts evenly between two shelves: it has only one peak.
SAC лучше PPO во всём?: Is SAC better than PPO in every way?
Нет: SAC экономит шаги взаимодействия, н: No: SAC saves interaction steps but spends several times more compute per step; in fast parallel simulation, PPO is chosen more often
Нет, SAC хуже по шагам, но быстрее по вр: No, SAC is worse in steps but faster in time
В лаборатории 1 SAC дошёл до 90% за 500: In Lab 1, SAC reached 90% in 500 steps and PPO in 1,250, while the number of multiplications to reach 90% came out about the same for both. On a robot, a step is expensive; in simulation, compute time is.
SERL научила руку вставлять разъём в пла: SERL taught an arm to insert a connector into a circuit board in 20 minutes. Does that mean RL on a real robot starts from scratch and does without people?
Нет: обучение начинали с 20 демонстраций: No: training started from 20 operator demonstrations, success was judged by a classifier or a sensor, and the scene reset was automated
Нет, SERL учили в симуляторе: No, SERL was trained in a simulator
Off-policy метод позволяет класть демонс: An off-policy method lets you put demonstrations right into the buffer: in SERL, half of every batch is drawn from them. The SAC authors' Minitaur learned from scratch, 160,000 steps in about two hours, but people had to pick it up after falls.
